review_findings.inventory_split: Static review confirms the runner refuses test_*.py inventory changes, compares the split legacy Python case IDs to the accepted archived G3 IDs, checks legacy class counts, compares G4 observed IDs to TC expected_g4_case_ids, and checks G4 count. Each Python phase has its own 300-second cap and retained JUnit/log evidence. It verifies and preserves the PostgreSQL lifecycle manifest after each phase so a later run cannot silently overwrite earlier shutdown evidence. Node retains its 180-second cap and exact 48-case no-skip condition.
review_findings.cleanup_delta: The newly added child ownership cleanup is still ancestry-scoped to this Linux gate via subreaper adoption. It snapshots /proc ancestry and starttime, opens pidfds, rechecks starttime before pidfd signaling, escalates bounded INT/TERM/KILL, reaps adopted exits, and fails the gate if any owned child remains alive. It handles session-detached descendants without process-group signaling. This static review does not replace the required real helper test.
review_findings.decision_alignment: The execution decision records the accepted archive hash, timing arithmetic, exact fixed inventory split, no omitted tests/no G6 claim, and its runner SHA matches the reviewed current runner.

blockers.evidence: The runner validates contract SHA, testcase-ID list and count, then captures current source bytes and checks they remain stable during the run. It does not validate that test_jobs.py and other G4 test inputs match the independent source_pins recorded in the TC ledger, and does not check a pinned ledger artifact SHA. Therefore an edited test body retaining the same pytest IDs/count can replace the reviewed oracle and still pass the gate.
blockers.required_resolution: Pin the final TC ledger SHA and verify it at gate start; verify every ledger source pin relevant to G4 test/fixture/provider bytes against current bytes before execution. Preserve the existing source-before/after comparison to catch mid-run changes. Include the exact G4 inventory and source pins in the frozen ledger.
